text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Early one morning during summer training 
camp—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A notification popped up on my smartphone, 
and when I checked it—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh. 'Mornin', Trainer.
choice_data_list:
You called me out here out of nowhere— 
what's going on?

You called me out here so suddenly— what's 
up?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for coming so early in the morning~ 
But I'm glad you're awake.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Could you step outside for a bit? —There's 
something I want to talk to you about.

Where Seiun Sky brought me was the beach. 
Perhaps because it's still early morning, 
there is no one around.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nope, totally off. This is a secret 
strategy meeting! We wanna conquer the 
Kikuka Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Um, could you please stop being at a loss 
for words?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, sure? I know that saying 'strategy 
meeting~' isn't really my style, but 
still.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...The Satsuki Sho and the Japan Derby. 
Sei-chan worked veeery hard."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Still, if we keep going like this, we're 
probably going to hit a wall, you know~?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yep. I've always been the kind of girl 
that nobody expected anything from, 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, not in a super serious way, okay? 
Just, well, Sei-chan's always been like 
this, as you can see.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is my fragile, delicate cuteness not 
getting through to you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Putting expectations on such a cute 
Umamusume would just be cruel, is what I 
mean!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Grandpa was the only one who showered me 
with praise, saying I had what it takes to 
win a Classic race.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ever since coming to Tracen Academy... and 
finally making my debut. Every single 
time, I'm shocked by how much I'm lacking.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Like having that natural late-stretch 
burst, or being clutch right when it 
counts the most.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Things I don't have, things I can never 
have. Everyone around me has so much... 
and yet, they still have so much room to 
grow.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I bet everyone who's known me since I was 
little is super surprised right now~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"I started with nothing at all, and here I 
am competing against talented girls."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I guess that's my limit. There's 
only so much growth and raw talent can 
make up for.”

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Everyone believes that Spe-chan and the 
others will come out of this summer even 
stronger than they were at the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...And I agree with that. If you take 
them on head-to-head, you probably won't 
win."
choice_data_list: Then what are you gonna do?
Then what are you going to do?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"The answer is... Running away from the 
fight! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
A head-on clash is a terrible idea! We 
won't be able to keep up, and it'll just 
end in total ruin.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Then... instead of matching their pace, we 
force them into ours.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what~?! Before I even realized it, 
Seiun Sky won?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Well, anyway, if we can just get a 
scream like that out of them, it's our 
win.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Blowing past everyone with pure speed or 
muscling through with raw power are both 
cool, but—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—My greatest ally is this brain of mine. 
Sei-chan is about to rule over time 
itself~♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Talent? Hardly. It's mere vanity, a 
trick with sleight of hand and props.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still, if I deceive them flawlessly, it 
becomes truth—it becomes results. That is 
my only chance of victory.

"Running away from the fray to win the 
race." Seizing victory entirely on her own 
terms— that, too, is a strength unique to 
Seiun Sky.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So from here on, I'd like to borrow your 
wisdom, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
A way to easily take over a race! Don't 
you have some kind of training like that~?

It was an unreasonable demand, but if we 
were strictly focusing on the Kikuka Sho, 
something did come to mind.
choice_data_list: Training to conquer the "Slopes of Yodo"

Tenacity training to hold the lead until 
the finish line

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho... It's true that conquering the 
hill is key at Kyoto Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still, please don't say 100 trips up the 
shrine stairs! ...or anything like that, 
okay~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: To be honest! It's completely impossible!!

Despite her grumbling, Seiun Sky trained 
diligently for me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —Oh? Isn't that over there... Sky!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No way... She's training, this early in 
the morning...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Special Week-san and Sky-san... will 
become even stronger, won't they?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: As one of the Big Three... I will—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Tenacity, huh~... Sounds intense. Still, 
that final push at the very end is gonna 
be crucial, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...How about the tenacity to outrun 
training itself! Does that count? No 
good~?

Despite her grumbling, Seiun Sky trained 
diligently for me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: —Oh? Isn't that over there... Sky!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No way... She's training, this early in 
the morning...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Special Week-san and Sky-san... will 
become even stronger, won't they?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: As one of the Big Three... I will—
